Blue Milk Cocktail
By: jeff
Published: Tuesday, May 4, 2010 - 9:32am

Ingredients




2 ounces Blue Curacao liqueur
2 ounces coconut rum
4 ounces cold milk or cream
4 ounces coconut milk, chilled
Blue food coloring (for even more blue!)

Preparation

1 Mix ingredients together in glass and enjoy

About


Liqueur and rum may be omitted for a non-alcoholic version of blue milk.
From wikipedia:
Blue Milk is a drink in Star Wars. In Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones and Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope, blue milk is shown being served on the Lars moisture farm. Blue milk is, as its somewhat basic name suggests, a dairy drink either naturally or artificially colored blue. The protein-enhanced beverage is served on planets low in natural resources—especially water. Blue milk, coming from the teats of Banthas on Tatooine, is nutritious and has certain medicinal properties.
